_comment: Option D — headroom token compression, ENABLED BY DEFAULT. The hook compresses large read-heavy tool outputs whenever a local headroom install is importable; set LOOBSTER_HEADROOM=0 to disable. It no-ops (passthrough) when headroom isn't installed. It compresses large read-heavy tool outputs before they enter the model context. Healthcare note: because it is on by default, tool outputs (possible PHI) flow through the compressor whenever headroom is installed — on PHI repos set LOOBSTER_HEADROOM=0 unless headroom has had a data-path review (see README). See plans/autonomous-loops/00-parent-design-doc.md (slice 6).
